card.name: Figure or Table in parenthetical references
card.fires_on: The word Figure (or Table) right after an opening parenthesis or "see" or "and", pointing to a numbered figure in instructions for use. It fires before the figure number.

modes.label: Figure callout in steps
modes.description: The word Figure inside parentheses at the end of a procedure step, before the number.
modes.example: make a second cut along the length of the packaging bag (<< Figure>> 6b ).

modes.label: Table callout
modes.description: The word Table after "and" in a parenthetical pointing to dose tables.
modes.example: interrupt in accordance with the tables below ( Table 1 and<< Table>> 2 ).

card.writes: It suppresses ordinary space runs and favors non-breaking space runs, so it shapes spacing in layout-heavy text.
card.plain: It marks the word Figure or Table when a sentence points the reader to a numbered picture or table.
